title: The Truth of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: When the end of that chain entered Chen Ji's sight, his pupils constricted sharply—the existence at the end of fate was actually the person he had been searching for all these years.

text.content: Deep night, Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Land. Chen Ji sat alone on a blue stone, moonlight like frost outlining his solitary silhouette. In his palm rested a yellowed page—the final fragment of the Tianji Record given to him by Mo Xiansheng. "The time has come," Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke low in his Mental Sea. "Combine this page with the other fragments, and you shall glimpse the full picture of the Tianji Record. But remember—the truth is often crueler than illusion." Chen Ji did not answer, merely slowly pressing the fragment to his chest where twelve fragments waited quietly.

The moment the final fragment touched his clothing, a torrential flow of information flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a flood. Twelve beams of light burst forth from his chest, intertwining, rotating, and merging in mid-air. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his Brow Center, as if something was forcibly carving marks onto his soul. The light gradually收敛, and a complete page hovered before him—this was the legendary Tianji Record, the complete version. "Finally... complete." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse; he could sense that the power contained within this page far exceeded all his previous understanding.

The pressure of the complete Tianji Record descended upon Chen Ji, and his breath stopped abruptly. Even the remnant of that pressure made his bones creak. Yet in the next moment, brilliant light erupted in his eyes—he could see! Now he could see everything within the next twelve hours! This was not the vague premonition of three hours, but a clear and complete rehearsal like a painted scroll! Chen Ji couldn't help but laugh uproariously toward the sky, the laughter echoing through the silent night, carrying a hint of audacity and catharsis. "So this is the power of the complete version? Indeed... terrifying beyond measure!"

As his consciousness delved deeper, countless visions began to appear before Chen Ji's eyes. The future of Tianqing Sect, the movements of Xuanwu Sect, the schemes of the Holy Sect, the布局 of the imperial court... Everything lay before him like an unfolded chessboard, for him to place pieces and decide moves. "This Tianji Record was truly made for me!" Chen Ji's voice carried irrepressible excitement as he began frantically deducing all possibilities within his Mental Sea. However, at this moment, his smile froze on his face. Because within those visions, he saw something that should not exist—a golden chain.

choice.prompt: The appearance of the golden chain set alarm bells ringing in Chen Ji's heart. He knew that every time the Tianji Record granted him power, there would inevitably be a price. This time, what was that chain?

choices.description: Since he had seen this chain, he could not pretend not to have seen it. Chen Ji decided to trace its本体 along the chain.
choices.visible_cost: May consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Discover the truth of the shackles in advance

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, gathering his consciousness into a thin thread, reaching toward the golden chain. The chain seemed close at hand, yet was far as the horizon; every approach felt like pulling at his soul. "Break!" He low shouted, forcibly extending his perception to the chain's end. In an instant, a blinding golden light erupted, illuminating Chen Ji's Mental Sea as bright as day.

choices.description: Cannot act rashly. Chen Ji decided to first use the Tianji Record's power to suppress this chain and see its true nature.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more complete information about the shackles

text.content: Chen Ji mobilized the power of the Tianji Record, forming a barrier within his Mental Sea that slowly pressed toward the golden chain. The chain let out a mournful cry, yet did not dissipate; instead, it grew increasingly bright. At this moment, Chen Ji saw its complete form—it was not an ordinary chain, but a chain of fate woven from countless tiny runes! "This is... the shackle?" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly.

dialogue.content: "You have seen it." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sounded in his Mental Sea, the voice carrying a complex emotion. "This is the truth of the Tianji Record—it has never been some magnificent fortune, but a carefully designed shackle. Every prophet throughout history has been a prisoner of this shackle." Chen Ji did not speak, merely staring at that golden chain. His fingers trembled slightly, whether from anger or fear. "Then," he finally spoke, his voice cold as frost, "who forged this shackle? And for what purpose?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then slowly said: "The Tianji Record has nine scrolls, each sealing a portion of the truth. And this shackle will continuously tighten as the Tianji Record becomes complete. When the nine scrolls are completely unified, that is the day the prophet is entirely devoured." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record in his hands, suddenly discovering that within those golden patterns, countless tiny chain marks were hidden! "Are you saying... every time I use the Tianji Record, I am feeding this shackle?" His voice carried a slight tremor. "Correct," Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed. "This is the truth of the Tianji Record—it grants you the ability to foresee the future, yet secretly抽取s your Heavenly Fate, ultimately forging you into a puppet."

Chen Ji abruptly rose to his feet, fists clenched tightly. Countless images flashed rapidly through his mind—every scene where he had used the Tianji Record, every premonition, every scheme... All those futures he had glimpsed, all those destinies he had rewritten, were feeding this formless beast! "Ha..." He suddenly laughed, that laughter carrying a hint of bitterness, a hint of self-mockery. "What a fine Tianji Record! What fine heavenly justice! So from the very beginning, I was merely a piece on someone else's chessboard!" His laughter grew louder and louder, finally transforming into a long roar toward the sky, echoing endlessly through the night.

Yet Chen Ji's laughter stopped abruptly. His gaze fell upon that golden chain, pupils constricting sharply—because he discovered a fatal problem. This chain was not connected to him alone. Its other end extended into the infinite Void, and within those shadows, countless points of light could be faintly seen—each of those points was a prophet who had been chosen by the Tianji Record! "So," Chen Ji's voice lowered, "all the prophets throughout history were merely consumables for this Tianji Record? Used and discarded?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul did not answer, but that silence itself was the best answer.

choice.prompt: The truth was like a basin of ice water poured over Chen Ji's head. He finally understood that the Tianji Record had never been any fortune, but a carefully designed trap. So, how should he face this cruel truth?

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record is a shackle, then destroy it! Chen Ji decided to forcefully break this binding of fate.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all abilities of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji let out a low roar, the True Qi in his body surging wildly, transforming into a brilliant sword light that slashed toward the Tianji Record. However, just as the sword light touched the pages, an invisible barrier repelled him, and the golden chains tightened abruptly, digging into the depths of his soul. "Hiss!" Chen Ji groaned, a trace of blood seeping from the corner of his mouth. But he did not retreat; instead, he gathered his strength once more and swung his sword a second time!

choices.description: Destroying the Tianji Record is the most foolish choice. Chen Ji decided to do the opposite, attempting to master this shackle.
choices.visible_reward: May discover the true secret of the shackle

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the fire of rage in his heart, and began to calmly examine this golden chain. Since this was a chess game set by the Heavenly Dao, he would turn the tables and make use of it! He slowly seeped his consciousness into the chain, like taming a mad beast. At first, the chain struggled violently, nearly tearing apart his Mental Sea. But Chen Ji gritted his teeth and endured, inch by inch, until finally, he touched the core of the chain—where an earth-shattering secret lay hidden.

dialogue.content: "You're insane!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed. "Master the shackle? Do you know what that means? Throughout the ages, how many talented and brilliant individuals have turned to bones on this path! You're merely..." Chen Ji interrupted him, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips: "I'm just atrash, right? Everyone thinks so. But precisely because I'm atrash, I know better than anyone—in desperate situations, the only way out is to be more insane than despair itself." His eyes gleamed with a dangerous light. "Since the Heavenly Dao wants to use this Tianji Record to refine me into a puppet, then let me show the Heavenly Dao what it means to bite the hand that feeds!"

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's consciousness delved into the core of the shackle, a vast stream of information flooded into his Mental Sea. These were memory fragments of all the prophets throughout the ages—their struggles, their despair, their deaths, all telling the same truth: the shackle of the Tianji Record was a web of fate woven by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Every prophet was merely a chess piece used by the Eye of Heavenly Dao to stir the winds of the world, discarded after use. However, just as Chen Ji was about to be drowned by this overwhelming wave of despair, he suddenly noticed a strange phenomenon—in this countless sea of memory fragments, one figure was different from all the others. It was the figure of a woman, bound by countless chains, yet never yielding. What shocked Chen Ji even more was that this woman's face was identical to that of his missing sister, Chen Nian!

Chen Ji's body froze abruptly. His heart felt like it was being gripped tightly by an invisible hand, making breathing difficult. "Nian Nian..." His voice was hoarse, almost unrecognizable. He desperately reached toward that figure, wanting to see more details. However, just then, that figure suddenly turned its head, meeting Chen Ji's gaze. Those were eyes full of pain and longing, yet in an instant, they were submerged by endless chains. "Nian Nian!" Chen Ji howled, True Qi surging violently from within him, yet unable to shake the shackle in the slightest. He finally understood—Chen Nian had been missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," and behind all this, there was such a deep connection to the shackle of the Tianji Record!

But the true shock was only beginning. When Chen Ji traced that chain to its end, he did not see the Eye of Heavenly Dao, nor any supreme being, but a figure he knew extremely well—a woman bound by the same chains as Chen Nian, yet always maintaining a clear consciousness. This woman's face perfectly matched the vague figure Chen Ji had seen countless times in his dreams. And on her body, there emanated a presence that made Chen Ji's very soul tremble—a resonance of blood connection. "This is..." Chen Ji's voice trembled intensely. "Impossible! Nian Nian... how could she possibly be..." He didn't finish, because the answer was already on the tip of his tongue. The shackle of the Tianji Record was not controlled by the Eye of Heavenly Dao alone. Its true core was connected to—Chen Nian.

choice.prompt: The truth exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a thunderclap. The core of the Tianji Record's shackle was actually connected to his missing sister Chen Nian. What did this mean? Was Chen Nian being used by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, or was she herself part of this shackle?

choices.text: Save Chen Nian at any cost
choices.description: Regardless of the truth, Chen Nian was his sister, his only kin in this world. Chen Ji decided that no matter the cost, he would rescue her from the shackles.
choices.visible_cost: May directly confront the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Gain direction to save Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into the enemy's trap

text.content: Crazy flames burned in Chen Ji's eyes. He recalled their childhood together, her tear-filled eyes when she was taken away, and the ever-present guilt in his heart over the years as he alone orchestrated the world. "Nian Nian..." His voice was low yet firm. "Brother is coming to save you. No matter what this Tianji Record is, no matter how powerful the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Brother will bring you back!" He suddenly opened his eyes, and in those eyes, there was no longer any hesitation or fear—only the resolve to burn his bridges!

choices.text: Question Mo Xiansheng about the truth
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul must know more. Chen Ji decided to extract the complete truth from him first, then make a decision.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Be Hiding Something

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the churning in his heart, his gaze sharp as a blade piercing into the remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng deep within his Mental Sea. "Mo Xiansheng," his voice was terrifyingly calm, "the shackles of the Tianji Record are connected to Nian Nian. You knew from the very beginning, didn't you?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent, and that silence caused Chen Ji's heart to sink little by little. After a long while, Mo Xiansheng's voice finally drifted forth: "What I know is far more than you can imagine. But some things... cannot be spoken of now." Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: "Cannot be spoken of? Or do you not wish to speak of it?" A dangerous glint flashed in his eyes, "Mo Xiansheng, I hope you understand one thing—I am not some chess piece that can be casually manipulated. If you still want me to complete your schemes, you'd better tell me the entire truth."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently trembled within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, as if locked in some intense internal struggle. Following an extended silence, his voice finally emerged with unprecedented gravity: "Very well... Since you've journeyed this far, there are indeed matters you must comprehend." Chen Ji remained silent, waiting intently. Mo Xiansheng continued: "Chen Nian is not merely an ordinary Heavenly Fate Lock Key. She is... the vessel chosen by the Heavenly Eye to bear the core of the shackles. From the moment of her birth, her fate has been inextricably bound to the Tianji Record." Chen Ji's fists clenched violently, his fingernails deeply embedding into his palms.

text.content: "And you," Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a complex nuance, "believed yourself to be the inheritor of the Tianji Record, the chosen prognosticator. But in truth, you are merely a tool used by the Heavenly Eye to safeguard Chen Nian. All your schemes, all your machinations—seemingly under your control—are actually paving the way for Chen Nian. What the Heavenly Eye desires was never a powerful prognosticator—it wants a chess piece capable of guiding Chen Nian toward a certain destined endpoint." Chen Ji felt his very blood flowing backward. His life's pride, his life's calculations—all turned to mockery in this moment. So he was not the Chess Player, but the most critical piece on the chessboard, propelled by an invisible hand, step by step toward a predestined conclusion.

"However," Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly shifted, "this does not mean you can only accept your fate." Chen Ji lifted his head sharply, flames rekindling in his eyes. Mo Xiansheng continued: "Though the Heavenly Eye's布局 is intricate, it has a fatal weakness—it cannot predict the emergence of variables. And you... are that greatest variable." A cold smile slowly curved Chen Ji's lips, a smile carrying both madness and resolve. "A variable?" he murmured, "Then let Heaven witness how much of the chessboard a single variable can overturn!" His voice echoed across the night sky, like a war drum, heralding the prelude to his confrontation with the Heavenly Eye. The mysteries of the complete Tianji Record were now revealed—it was shackles, a trap, the binding of his fate. But now, he would no longer flee. He would personally shatter these chains, rescue Chen Nian, and completely overturn the Heavenly Eye's scheme!
